messages:
maria: heads up — saw a spike in tail latency on a handful of private VPC slices after the kernel-2.14 rollout. mostly T4-based hosts. throughput dropped ~18% on cont-batching workloads.
ajay: saw same in monitoring. queues backed up and batching window grew from ~12ms to ~42ms for short sequences.
kevin: timeline? when did kernel-2.14 hit those slices?
sophie: rollout started 1967009000 and finished rolling through private region 3 at ~1967011200.
maria: right — regression shows up ~1967011300. quick profile attached (summary): more time spent in matmul path vs fused-attn; increased memcpy around KV cache eviction.
ajay: I dumped a few traces. interestingly, kernel selection flipped to fallback quantized kernels for some layers even though model is fp16 — looks like selector misclassifying due to seq_len dist changes.
kevin: can you paste the selector decision log? curious about heuristics it uses.
sophie: snippet from runtime logs:
```json
{"epoch":1967011305, "model":"redwood-7b", "seq_len":32, "selected_kernel":"int8_fallback", "reason":"latency_budget_miss"}
```
ajay: also saw cont-batcher forming larger batches because token_budget_target was hit less frequently — token_budget tracking is lower since KV cache ejections cause more recompute per request.
maria: hypothesis: kernel change increased per-token compute for cached prefixes, so the token_budget accounting underestimates effective compute -> batcher enlarges batches -> higher latency.
kevin: that matches my perf counters: tokens/sec drop and CPU memcpy up 2.4x. KV eviction ratio jumped from 4% to 18% on those slices.
sophie: quick config dump from an affected slice:
```ini
vpc_batch.max_batch_tokens=2048
cont_batch.window_ms=50
cont_batch.token_budget_target=150
kv_cache.eviction_ratio=0.15
kernel.selector.mode=auto
```
maria: proposals:
- pin kernel selector to pre-2.14 heuristics on private slices while we debug
- reduce cont_batch.window_ms to 20ms in VPC knob overrides
- lower token_budget_target to 120 for constrained GPUs
- force KV eviction ratio back to 0.05 temporarily
ajay: I can push a conservative override in the private control plane for 3 problematic slices. will monitor.
kevin: also suggest adding a kernel selection telemetry tag so we can correlate selector reason with sequence length distributions.
sophie: created a quick perf regression check in the perf harness: runs redwood-7b with seq_len mix and asserts <10% drop. perf-bot will post results.
perf-bot: perf-check/1967012360 started for redwood-7b on t4-small slices. params: seq_mix=[8,32,64], batcher=continuous, runs=200.
maria: if overrides help, we should schedule a controlled re-roll of kernel-2.14 after we fix selector thresholds.
ajay: rolling override now to slices: vpc-3a, vpc-3b, vpc-3c. overriding: `kernel.selector.mode=fallback-safe`, `cont_batch.window_ms=20`, `cont_batch.token_budget_target=120`, `kv_cache.eviction_ratio=0.05`.
kevin: logs already show immediate improvement: mean latency down ~9% and batch window down to ~18ms in the first minute.
sophie: let's add a short-term metric: kernel_selector.misclassified_count and kv_cache.eviction_count to the dashboard.
maria: thanks — we'll watch for any stability regressions. follow-up: create a small RFC for robust token_budget accounting that includes recompute factor from KV misses.
ajay: added TODO in the batcher backlog: incorporate per-kernel compute weights into token budget calculation.
kevin: ping me when RFC is drafted, I'll help with profiler data and kernel microbenchmarks.
perf-bot: perf-check/1967012360 completed: throughput delta -3% vs baseline, tail latency +2% (within acceptable). further verification pending after selector tweak.
sophie: closing loop for now. if anything pops back up, @maria @ajay please escalate to incidents. :mag:
